parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation (decalcohol... ) — sorry, no trans criminalisation, decriminalised since 2008, health protections covering gender identity, Pride since 1991, and no documented universal-exposure rule (no facility, border, custody or document restriction). Against that: trans women are the consistently most-targeted group, state police appear among assault perpetrators, an official report places anti-LGBTI abuse inside a climate of uninvestigated impunity, and the dossier states violence is culturally accepted, legally unenforced and unreported with dismal legal outcomes — tier-2 state-tolerated targeting with essentially no working recourse, plus suppressed media. Counts are raw, undenominator'd and modest, so frequency evidence is limited rather than campaign-level. Resident-facing family-law and opinion data carry little visitor weight. Net: documented state-tolerated hostility toward the most visible trans group without a universal institutional exposure, sitting at the top of High Risk / lower Elevated.
